Mara: Quick sync  finalize hero chart for the bench launch and inbound routing. Need a single-screen claim for the blog + a short 30m webinar plan.
Alex: Hero = scatter (median latency on x, $/1k tokens on y) colored by deployment. Callout dot for median improvement. Keep copy non-technical.
Sam: I'll export a compact CSV (deployment, median_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, cost_per_1k, tokens_per_req). Also a small violin for p99 to use in the tech appendix. ETA EOD.
Priya: Headline idea: "Clearer inference economics." Subhead: "Predictable latency and lower unit cost across hosted, dedicated, and private." CTA: "Run your workload  get a tailored latency & cost brief in 48h."
Noah: Routing rule: if Expected_RPS >= 50 OR Compliance includes SOC2/PCI/HIPAA -> Enterprise queue; else -> Growth. Tag leads with Interest: latency|cost|throughput. Fields: Expected_RPS__c, Compliance_Requirements__c, Benchmark_Interest__c.
Jen: Webinar 30m: 10m claims + demo (scatter), 10m tech deep-dive (violin + throughput), 10m Q&A. Outreach blurbs for PMs, Infra, Platform.
Mara: Methodology note: tokens = prompt + response; Dedicated = reserved pools baseline. No vendor names.
Sam: CSV placeholder: https://internal.storage/redwood/bench/1743219999.csv
launch-bot: Reminder: Webinar slot requested 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC. Please confirm within 48h. :calendar:
